'''Gjo'Fomaan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Coynite/Legends|Coynite]] warrior and ''[[Tawws'Kroyn]]'' champion. He was a noted arena [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] fighter during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and a strong supporter of the [[Galaxy Gladiator Federation]].
